entries.german: Eberhard v. Rosenberg u. Johann v. Randeck quittieren dem Pfzgrn. Ruprecht über eine an sie wegen des Erzbischofs v. Mainz geleistete Zahlung von 1876 Pfd. 5 sol. 4 H.
entries.english: Eberhard von Rosenberg and Johann von Randeck acknowledge receipt from Palatine Count Rupert of a payment made to them on behalf of the Archbishop of Mainz in the amount of 1876 pounds 5 solidi 4 Heller.

facts.content: with Johann von Randeck acknowledged payment from Count Palatine Ruprecht on behalf of the archbishop of Mainz.
